sourceProof.laneProof: Every connected component carries one material. Each ordinary belt has at most one incoming entity: direction changes are sole-input corners, not competing side loads. Unfiltered splitters preserve the two lane identities while distributing each lane across their two outputs; reciprocal underground pairs preserve lanes. Both lanes remain available through each branch. No merged feeds, priorities, filters, chest sharing or mixed-material lanes are accepted.
